verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is a SaaS invoicing product, and a product of this kind could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a command-line tool. The probes find only a generic llms.txt and 404s for the markdown docs and OpenAPI paths, none of which is a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
